# Research report formats

For research-report work, follow
`adc-template/standards/conventions/research-reports.md`.
Keep existing report formats and the evidence-driven ECharts interactive format
as parallel choices; do not replace the earlier template or overwrite releases.
All reports must support dark reading; interactive charts must follow the page
theme. Use evidence-backed inputs, offline packaging, version-before-language
filenames and the convention's validation checklist.
Do not infer that changing template files publishes a central ADC release or
updates existing project bindings.
